name: getpaymentenv-does-not-exist
hook: getPaymentEnv() does not exist in env.ts — the actual functions are getStripeEnv() and getPayPalEnv()
body: When adding @ai-summary headers to payment modules in PR #204, the PR incorrectly changed JSDoc references from getStripeEnv()/getPayPalEnv() to getPaymentEnv(). The env.ts module does not export a getPaymentEnv function. Always verify function names against the actual implementation before updating documentation.
why: The PR author (or AI) assumed a getPaymentEnv() wrapper existed that doesn't. This would have caused a runtime crash if merged. The typecheck caught it post-merge.
